summary: Added a production decision verifier after first capturing a red missing-module test. The gate refuses missing approval, invalid scope, absent rollback acknowledgement, missing runtime evidence, stale evidence, and decisions that predate evidence. Success requires rerunning runtime readiness plus explicit owner approval and a non-secret approval reference. The operator surface, package scripts, README, runbook, release surface check, and audit are aligned. All 34 tests and every package verify command pass.
remaining_blockers: The production gate still requires an explicit owner approval reference after evidence review.
